description: Fallback watchlist used when no portfolio.json is provided. Organized by the signal-layer thesis the ticker expresses. Edit freely.

energy_complex.thesis: Direct exposure to oil price, refining margins, and geopolitical supply shocks.

rate_sensitive_duration.thesis: Beneficiaries of falling real rates and weaker dollar; suffer on hawkish surprises.

broad_macro_proxies.thesis: Capture the top-level risk-on / risk-off regime.

credit_risk_signals.thesis: Credit-layer risk-appetite gauges; divergence from equity is the signal.

defensive_rotation.thesis: Outperform when macro regime turns defensive.

semiconductors_and_ai.thesis: High beta to AI capex cycle and China-export-restriction headlines.

travel_and_reopening.thesis: Sensitive to consumer health, oil price, and travel demand narrative.

agriculture_and_fertilizer.thesis: Food/fertilizer supply chain exposure; sensitive to sanctions, weather, trade policy.
